text:
Type: rustic horse portrait print
Use: wall decoration above a sofa, bed or fireplace; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: farmhouse, rustic
Materials: print with whitewashed wood plank effect, black wood frame
Colors: off-white, black
Shape: large square, black frame, horse head in profile with ink splatters over horizontal plank lines, oversized
Feel: earthy, bold, relaxed
Goes with: white walls, reclaimed wood, black iron, leather; farmhouse or rustic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Printed Rustic Wood Effect Horse Wall Art, Black Frame, 40" x 40"
product.description: What appears at first glance to be a print on wood is actually on textured paper. This black and white rendering of a handsome equine arrives in a black frame, ready to hang in a horse-lover's room of any style. 40"W x 40"H Print on paper in a frame with a black finish Modern rustic subject and printing effect Ready to hang, all hardware included
